articles.title: American Water Offers Convenient Ways for Customers to Pay Their Bills
articles.mainIdea: American Water Offers Convenient Ways for Customers to Pay Their Bills
articles.summary: PR Newswire: American Water Offers Convenient Ways for Customers to Pay Their Bills. American Water (NYSE: AWK), the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the U.S., wants to remind customers that it provides secure and convenient bill payment options through its online portal, MyWater. The company recently broadened its platform to accept Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, PayPal or PayPal Credit when enrolling in its Auto Pay program or making a one-time payment to make it easier for customers to pay their bills. Related tickers mentioned: AWK.

The Federal Trade Commission has contacted leading payment providers, including PayPal, Stripe, Visa and Mastercard, to examine the growing issue of debanking. articles.title: PayPal Lawsuits And CEO Shakeup Put Focus On Valuation Gap
articles.mainIdea: PayPal Lawsuits And CEO Shakeup Put Focus On Valuation Gap
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: PayPal Lawsuits And CEO Shakeup Put Focus On Valuation Gap. Multiple securities fraud class action lawsuits have been filed against PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS:PYPL). The lawsuits follow a surprise CEO change and the withdrawal of long term financial targets. Plaintiffs allege misleading statements about growth prospects and business execution. These events raise legal and reputational risks that may influence investor sentiment and oversight of the company.
